lede: Cache 1.1 is in testing on phones. It becomes stable when every must-have below works on each kind of device and Ask is fast enough.

lines.text: Launch check on a Pixel 8: the new Library, Bookshelves, adding a PDF with OCR, search inside it, Ask with a cited page, Discover, a route with guidance.
To TestFlight (public testers) and Google Play testing.
Google Play for everyone, until Ask meets its speed and accuracy goals.
New Library and Bookshelves, adding PDFs with OCR, search inside your books.
Watched folders: new PDFs you drop in a folder are added on their own.
A clearer log for problem reports.
Android Auto, released together with CarPlay.
